items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: Rick Montalbano, longtime friend of Ronnie and a previous interviewee of the Archive.

ctx.x: That’s my question. How do you keep focused?

That’s the main, man, the focusing is the main thing. It’s like — it’s — that’s the problem. You have to keep focusing. But with me I have so much to do — I’m playing drums, I’m playing percussion, I’m playing some orchestra bells, I’m jumping around a lot you know. We’re on stage. We can see the show. But that’s like I have to just keep focused man. If I start wandering and thinking about like something else, getting my car fixed or something, man you know four bars go by and I say oops, where am I. You know how…
